author: Davish
body:
Well met comrades, Davish here! Since I've played on this server for just about a week I'd like to share my opinion on it so far. First off, I'm glad to say that I'm enjoying it just as much as I did with Minebattle in its glory days! I'm very happy to say that this server has been bringing me back to those days, it feels like a new beginning. I really enjoy the fresh new maps I've never experienced in DTM and CTW before, however I've noticed there are only a few aspects that are a bit lacking, but I really can't say I have a huge problem with. The player limits may need to be slightly increased by maybe one or two slots, but I see how it's enticing more rank purchases, for which if I had the resources to do so I'd be happy to get one. Also, the other thing is a lack of maps with TNT supplies on them, so far I have only seen one map with it, and I amazed everyone with a cannon I learned how to make on OCN, but on a server with the current player count, more TNT maps would be pretty nice. I really like how there's hidden Diamond Blocks/ supplies on many of the maps, makes things quite engaging. As for suggestions, if DTC can be added, I'll sure as hell approve. I guess that's really all I can say so far, in addition to the fact that I can now have a decent KD for once xD. So yeah, that's it, and I'm certainly going to keep playing on here, and maybe one of these days I'll start making videos again on here, if my recording software allows for decent fps xD.
Edit: One thing I left out by mistake, that I actually see as my only really big problem, is the server lag. It's sometimes at the point where if i just relog it fixes itself,but man it's quite the inconvenience.

replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body:
Glad your happy.
If you're going to buy a rank, unless you are only looking to purchase once, get diamond.
All ranks are the same except a few extra boosts, its no longer worth purchasing a rank, even diamond but you get the most out of the rank while its the cheapest long term (after a year).
I know because
1. Research on the shop page
2. Feedback of ranks from others after giveaways of mine or just peoplr who have purchased ranks
3. Me being the person who has probably spent the most money on this server in the shop (rounded up $233 from what I remember, if not, even more), so again comes to #1, research if I should do giveaways or not, but I got experience working with all ranks too ;)

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
I know that we don't, I'm just saying that it can be used for that gamemode as well.

TNT+TDM actually won't be rip, it's just a battle of attrition. You killing some dudes on the enemy team, TNT just makes it more convenient.

Give me reasons why TNT would not really work with TDM other than the fact that it makes killing things easier because that's the point.

It could be said that TNT isn't really needed for DTM, but then we could also say that kit-based combat for DTM isn't needed and loadouts aren't needed when you can use chests and vice versa.

It could also be said that DTM isn't really needed either.

The point isn't whether it's needed, the point is whether it makes things fun and on OCN and CherrylandMC... it's hella fun!
